record_scope_reconstruction: Bolivian health-worker protest at the Yacuiba–Salvador Mazza road bridge, July 22–28, 2024. Vehicles queued on both sides; negotiated temporary passage included buses and light vehicles toward Argentina. Police cleared the crossing on July 28. Intermittent permissions do not create a separate geographic site.

source_checks.finding: Primary Bolivian ombudsman report inspected: July 22 temporary pause enabled three international buses and fifteen light vehicles toward Argentina; not a final reopening.
July 28 report inspected: police cleared the international bridge after seven days; cargo and buses had been stranded on both sides, traffic resumed in both directions.
